data.raw_text:
TRIGGER WARNING: Sensitive content

A man died after he was hit by a bus while attempting to flee from police officers who were trying to arrest him in Pasay City.

According to a report by Vonne Aquino on “24 Oras Weekend” on Sunday, the suspect was flagged down for using an improvised license plate on his vehicle. Upon verification of his identity, authorities discovered that he had three standing warrants of arrest for estafa issued in Zamboanga City.

The suspect allegedly resisted arrest and injured some of the police escorts before managing to break free and run away, the report said. Police said the man was struck by a passing bus while fleeing. The bus driver is now under the custody of the Pasay City Police’s Vehicular Traffic Investigation Section. He declined to issue a statement.

Read more: https://t.co/zknrGMbt61
